review_output: {"summary":"I found no blockers or major regressions in the four files. The previous MINOR is fixed: `listCanonicalMigrations` now stops on any directory that holds a `migration.sql` but has a noncanonical name, and the runner, the diagnostic and the tests now share the same name allowlist: `\\d{8}` or `\\d{12,14}`, then `_` and `[a-z0-9_]+`. Ordering stays consistent. JS default sort and Prisma's byte-wise sort by directory name agree for ASCII names, and `migrationRows` re-sorts before comparing. A directory with a valid name but no SQL still fails safely through `migration-file-missing` in `writeMirror`. The 8-digit matcher also behaves: backtracking stops it from matching inside 9–11 digit tokens, and the allowlist filters out untrusted names. Two minor, non-blocking findings follow. An empty findings list here would not have certified the test or release results. Those depend on the reported 31/31 real disposable-database runs, which I did not see.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","file":"scripts/prisma-loopback-disposable-migration-runner.mjs","area":"main(): `const migrations = listCanonicalMigrations();` before the try/finally","issue":"The new `migration-name-noncanonical` error is thrown before the receipt object and the try/finally exist. The run ends with an uncaught rejection from the top-level `await main()`, and no failure receipt is written.","evidence":"`listCanonicalMigrations()` now throws (the fix in this revision). In `main()` it is called outside the `try { ... } finally { cleanup(...); writeReceipt(receipt); }` block, so `writeReceipt` never runs on this path. Any earlier PASS receipt at `.ai-team/reports/prisma-loopback-disposable-migration-receipt.json` stays on disk unchanged.","impact":"This still fails safely for `--verify-receipt`, because `verifyReceipt` calls `listCanonicalMigrations()` and throws too. But a stale `status: \"PASS\"` receipt can survive a run that actually failed. Anything that reads `receipt.status` without going through `verifyReceipt` would be misled, and the failure category is never recorded in the sanitized receipt.","recommended_fix":"Move discovery inside the try block. Initialize `migrationNames: []`, assign it after discovery succeeds, and let the existing catch record `failure.category = \"migration-name-noncanonical\"`. Alternatively, write a BLOCKED_OR_FAILED receipt before rethrowing.","required_test":"Using a fixture migrations root (or an injected directory) containing `2026101_bad/migration.sql`, run `main()` and assert three things: the receipt file is overwritten with `status: \"BLOCKED_OR_FAILED\"`, `failure.category` is `\"migration-name-noncanonical\"`, and the process exit code is 1.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"scripts/prisma-loopback-disposable-migration-runner.mjs","area":"listCanonicalMigrations(): `entry.isDirectory()` checks in the guard and the filter","issue":"Entries that are symlinks or junctions are skipped without any error, by both the noncanonical-name guard and the canonical filter. That leaves the same class of silent filtering the previous MINOR was about.","evidence":"`readdirSync(..., { withFileTypes: true })` returns Dirents for which `isDirectory()` is false when the entry is a symlink or junction, even if it points to a directory. Neither check looks at `isSymbolicLink()`, so such an entry is neither rejected nor listed.","impact":"If a migration directory is ever linked rather than copied (for example a junction on Windows), Prisma could still apply it from the real `prisma/migrations`, while the disposable mirror leaves it out. The runner could then produce a PASS receipt for a history that differs from what deploys. This is unlikely in practice.","recommended_fix":"Fail closed on any `entry.isSymbolicLink()` (or any entry that is not a regular directory) that contains a `migration.sql`, or reject symlinked entries outright with a dedicated error code.","required_test":"In a temp root, create a symlink or junction with a canonical migration name that points to a directory containing `migration.sql`. Assert that `listCanonicalMigrations(tempRoot)` throws instead of returning a list without that migration. Skip the test where symlinks are not permitted.","confidence":0.35}]}
